1: // Minimal Astro Dodge game targeting <canvas id="game"></canvas>
2: // Ship (blue triangle) moves with arrow keys, asteroids (gray circles) come from right,
3: // power‑ups (green squares) grant a temporary shield. Lose on collision or timer.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not present
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
10:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
11:   // Audio setup
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:   }
23: 
24:   // Game state
25:   const ship = { x: 80, y: height / 2, size: 20, speed: 4 };
26:   let asteroids = [];
27:   let powerUps = [];
28:   let shield = false;
29:   let shieldTimer = 0;
30:   let score = 0;
31:   let timeLeft = 30; // seconds
32:   let gameOver = false;
33:   // Visual enhancements
34:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
35:     x: Math.random() * width,
36:     y: Math.random() * height,
37:     r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
38:     twinkle: Math.random()
39:   }));
40:   let particles = [];
41: 
42:   // Input handling
43:   const keys = {};
44:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
45:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
46: 
47:   // Spawn functions
48:   function spawnAsteroid() {
49:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 10;
50:     asteroids.push({ x: width + radius, y: Math.random() * height, r: radius, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 + score / 1000 });
51:   }
52:   function spawnPowerUp() {
53:     const size = 12;
54:     powerUps.push({ x: width + size, y: Math.random() * height, size, speed: 2 });
55:     // Play power‑up spawn sound
56:     playTone(800, 0.07);
57:   }
58: 
59:   // Timers
60:   const asteroidInterval = setInterval(spawnAsteroid, 1000);
61:   const powerUpInterval = setInterval(spawnPowerUp, 10000);
62:   const countdown = setInterval(() => {
63:     if (!gameOver) {
64:       timeLeft--;
65:       if (timeLeft <= 0) gameOver = true;
66:     }
67:   }, 1000);
68: 
69:   function update() {
70:     if (gameOver) return;
71:     // Ensure audio context is running after first interaction
72:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') {
73:       window.addEventListener('click', () => audioCtx.resume(), { once: true });
74:       window.addEventListener('keydown', () => audioCtx.resume(), { once: true });
75:     }
76:     // Move ship
77:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
78:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
79:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
80:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
81:     // Keep inside bounds
82:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, ship.x));
83:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, ship.y));
84: 
85:     // Move asteroids
86:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.x -= a.speed);
87:     asteroids = asteroids.filter(a => a.x + a.r > 0);
88: 
89:     // Move power‑ups
90:     powerUps.forEach(p => p.x -= p.speed);
91:     powerUps = powerUps.filter(p => p.x + p.size > 0);
92: 
93:     // Update stars twinkle
94:     stars.forEach(s => {
95:       s.twinkle += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
96:       s.r = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(2.5, s.r + s.twinkle));
97:     });
98: 
99:     // Update particles
100:     particles.forEach(p => {
101:       p.x += p.vx;
102:       p.y += p.vy;
103:       p.life--;
104:     });
105:     particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);
106: 
107:     // Collisions
108:     asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
109:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
110:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
111:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
112:       if (dist < a.r + ship.size / 2) {
113:         if (shield) {
114:           // destroy asteroid on shield hit with particle burst and sound
115:           particles.push(...Array.from({length:10},()=>({
116:             x:a.x,
117:             y:a.y,
118:             vx:(Math.random()-0.5)*2,
119:             vy:(Math.random()-0.5)*2,
120:             life:30,
121:             size:a.r/2
122:           })));
123:           playTone(500, 0.08);
124:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
125:           shield = false;
126:         } else {
127:           // collision without shield ends game with sound
128:           playTone(200, 0.2);
129:           gameOver = true;
130:         }
131:       }
132:     });
133:     powerUps.forEach((p, i) => {
134:       if (Math.abs(p.x - ship.x) < p.size && Math.abs(p.y - ship.y) < p.size) {
135:         shield = true;
136:         shieldTimer = 180; // frames (~3 seconds at 60fps)
137:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
138:         // Shield activation sound
139:         playTone(600, 0.1);
140:       }
141:     });
142:     if (shield) shieldTimer--;
143:     if (shieldTimer <= 0) shield = false;
144: 
145:     // Score
146:     score++;
147:   }
148: 
149: function draw() {
150:     // Background gradient
151:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
152:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
153:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
154:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
155:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
156: 
157:     // Stars (twinkling)
158:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
159:     stars.forEach(s => {
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     });
164: 
165:     // Particles (explosions)
166:     particles.forEach(p => {
167:       const alpha = p.life / 30;
168:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,0,${alpha})`;
169:       ctx.beginPath();
170:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
171:       ctx.fill();
172:     });
173: 
174:     // Ship with gradient outline when shielded
175:     ctx.save();
176:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
177:     ctx.fillStyle = shield ? '#00f8' : '#00f';
178:     ctx.beginPath();
179:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size / 2);
180:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size / 2, ship.size / 2);
181:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size / 2, ship.size / 2);
182:     ctx.closePath();
183:     ctx.fill();
184:     if (shield) {
185:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#0ff';
186:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
187:       ctx.stroke();
188:     }
189:     ctx.restore();
190: 
191:     // Asteroids with subtle shading
192:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
193:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
194:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#888');
195:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
196:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
197:       ctx.beginPath();
198:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
199:       ctx.fill();
200:     });
201: 
202:     // Power‑ups with glow
203:     powerUps.forEach(p => {
204:       ctx.save();
205:       ctx.shadowColor = '#0f0';
206:       ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
207:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0c0';
208:       ctx.fillRect(p.x - p.size / 2, p.y - p.size / 2, p.size, p.size);
209:       ctx.restore();
210:     });
211: 
212:     // HUD
213:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
214:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
215:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score / 60)}`, 10, 20);
216:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${timeLeft}s`, 10, 40);
217:     if (gameOver) {
218:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
219:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
220:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
221:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
222:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 10);
223:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${Math.floor(score / 60)}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 20);
224:     }
225:   }
226:   }
227: 
228:   function loop() {
229:     update();
230:     draw();
231:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
232:   }
233: 
234:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
235: })();
